rows.label: Inference
rows.bridge: With PC1 high and Q124 off, OUT follows the bus through R134 and the match, and the bridge ties it to PC14 (U1.8). PC14's output is characterised only at +/-3 mA (DS12110 Table 159), so it cannot hold the pin against the bus through about 4 ohm (R134 and the match): in any PC14 state the pin is driven far above its supply and its protection conducts. The current that passes before the pin fails is not known and may exceed the match's 0.30 A no-fire, so firing is not excluded. A bridge present at power-up moves the cold OUT reading to PC14's level, which the CONT / BUS bands refuse (R23 firmware rule 3 also toggles PC14 during the cold screen).
